workflows.name: Plan a literature unit: a public-domain novel on Gutenberg and its film adaptation on IMDb
steps: In the Project Gutenberg tab, click the search box, type "{book}" and press Enter
Open the matching book and note its author and its download count from the bibliographic record
Switch to the IMDb tab, click the search box, type "{book}" and press Enter; open the first film adaptation and note its year and IMDb rating
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Unit: {book} by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>" and press Enter

workflows.name: Prepare a geography fact card from Wikipedia and the capital's local time
steps: In the Wikipedia tab, click the search box, type {country} and open the country article
From the infobox, note the population, official language(s) and currency
Switch to the timeanddate tab, click the search box, type {capital}, press Enter and open its current local time page; note the time
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Geography: {country}, capital {capital}, pop <population>, <language>, <currency>, time now <time>" and press Enter

workflows.name: Plan a class museum trip: ticket on Viator, address on OpenStreetMap, then email parents
steps: In the Viator tab, click the search box, type "{museum} tickets" and press Enter
Open the first result and note its name, price and duration. Do not click Check availability, Reserve or Book
Switch to the OpenStreetMap tab, click the search box, type "{museum}, {city}", press Enter and click the first result; note the address in the side panel
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type parents@example.com, click Subject and type "Class trip: {museum} on {date}"
Click Body and type "Dear parents, on {date} we visit {museum} (<address>). Ticket <price> per student, about <duration>." Do not click Send. Click Discard

noise.description: Open a new tab, go to bbc.com/news, scroll through the headlines, open one story, skim it, close the tab
Open a new tab, go to allrecipes.com, scroll the home page, open one recipe, skim it, close the tab
Abandoned attempt: in the IMDb tab, search "Dune", scroll the results, then give up without opening any
Wander: click through the Notes, Mail and Project Gutenberg tabs without doing anything, scroll the Notes list
Open a new tab, go to news.ycombinator.com, scroll the front page, open one comment thread, close the tab
